query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH wi.workItemCode AS workItemCode,c.companyName AS company,count(DISTINCT r) AS count ORDER BY workItemCode ASC,count DESC,company ASC WITH workItemCode,collect({company:company,count:count})[0..5] AS topCompanies RETURN workItemCode,topCompanies
